_readme: ARMED 2026-07-25. Each entry quotes the line that was actually read, then
says what it is. None is a client name, a deal amount, or a real
interaction: they are type annotations, docstring parameters, public
citations, table rows, our own Apify/Gamma tool-cost guidance, and test
The first armed version used 7 canned sentences made unique by appending a
fingerprint, which walked around the gate's own anti-bulk-accept guard.
The guard now strips a trailing `— path [class] hash` before comparing, so
that route is closed and these reasons had to be rewritten to survive it.
Reviewable only because the classifier was narrowed first: `name` and
`date` are no longer fact signals (118 and 90 of 253 findings, not one a
client). 253 -> 29. Re-baseline with rebaseline_document(); do not hand-edit.
